text: 【周末要闻回顾】2026年7月份居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%；中国央行连续第21个月增持黄金；中国7月PPI月率 -0.7%，前值-0.3%；国家统计局：7月份，猪肉价格同比下降13.3%；北京出台房地产新政策 适度提高住房公积金最高贷款额度。
text_en: 【Weekend News Review】Consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year in July 2026; PBOC increased gold reserves for the 21st consecutive month; China's July PPI fell 0.7% month-on-month, prior -0.3%; NBS: Pork prices fell 13.3% year-on-year in July; Beijing introduced new property policies to moderately raise the maximum housing provident fund loan limit.
